The course gives a deep understanding of the principles of system design of wireless networks and applications, with regards to performance aspects. The course mainly focuses on network systems for Internet of Everything (IoE). The course goal is to go beyond "ordinary" Internet applications. The course includes topics as cellular networks, wireless LANs, self-organizing network architectures, sensor networks, and data communication and networks for outer space and underwater.
